scientific_question: Does replacing one arbitrary pinned route with an existential widest-path objective on the same training-only teacher-medial corridor teach longitudinal M7-fragment joins without increasing radial girth?

round4_evidence.finding: The fixed-route floor tied the 9-of-16 incumbent at weight 0.03125, fell to 8-of-16 at larger weights, monotonically degraded ordinary validation, and reduced anti-blob passes at weight 0.25.

single_model_change.from: one-sided floor on the weakest ten percent of one fixed minimum-off-axis path
single_model_change.to: one-sided floor on the maximum bottleneck connectivity of any path through the audited teacher-medial corridor
unchanged: strict 16-slice held-out gate and every gate tolerance

loss_contract.name: teacher-medial-dynamic-widest-path-connectivity-v1
loss_contract.event: one audited training-only teacher component that joins two to four published-M7 components
loss_contract.corridor: the complete minimum-dilation teacher-medial corridor already computed for that event
loss_contract.pins: the published-M7 component contact sets inside the corridor
loss_contract.free_anchors: corridor voxels within one voxel of published M7 plus every pin voxel; their path capacity is clamped to one and they receive no growth pressure
loss_contract.recurrence: reach[0]=source pins; reach[t+1]=max(reach[t], min(student foreground probability, 26-neighbor max-pool(reach[t]))) within the corridor
loss_contract.score: the minimum, over non-source pin sets, of their maximum reached capacity; equivalently the bottleneck of the best set of source-to-pin paths
loss_contract.penalty: one-sided foreground-logit hinge below the independently fixed probability floor
loss_contract.event_weighting: one vote per event regardless of corridor size or number of pins

anti_blob_scope.reason: Keep the comparison single-axis. The existing separation losses and unchanged held-out anti-blob gate remain active; a center-to-shell contrast is reserved for a later isolated intervention only if dynamic connectivity opens joins by thickening them.

preflight_requirements: Every materialized corridor contains all of its pins and connects them within 96 propagation steps.
Spatial augmentation transforms event IDs, pin memberships, and free-anchor masks identically.
A stronger alternative route suppresses loss even when the former fixed route is weak.
Disconnected or sub-floor best paths retain a positive gradient on a bottleneck corridor voxel.
No direct connectivity gradient appears outside the corridor or on free M7 anchors.
The exact 1024-sample schedule and CUDA checkpoint are audited before selecting weights.

run_policy.candidate_values: set only after the exact-schedule CUDA loss-scale audit

next_report_layout.primary_view: one held-out slice per row with plain CT, teacher, published M7, incumbent, and every candidate side by side
